about: Which Desktop journeys a change can affect. tools/verify-desktop/affected.py reads this; DESKTOP.md explains it.

prerequisites.why: The driver, its fixture, plugin registration or Desktop loading changed: re-drive every journey.

note-save-reopen.proves: In a real isolated Desktop: Spaces opens, a note typed into the synthetic notebook saves, shows, survives leave and reopen, and matches the plugin SQLite store.

chat-build-and-refresh.proves: Building a Space in a normal chat and Refresh/upkeep need a model route. The driver switches the host's free-tier guest off, so these journeys stay outside it until a separately approved model route exists.
